![PhenotypeSpace logo](reference/figures/PhenotypeSpace_sticker.png)

[PhenotypeSpace](https://github.com/maRce10/PhenotypeSpace) is intended
to facilitate the quantification of phenotypic space features.

The package offers functions for:

- Estimate absolute values of phenotypic spaces
- Compare trait spaces across groups
- Modify output formats to facilitate statistical analysis

All functions allow the parallelization of tasks, which distributes the
tasks among several processors to improve computational efficiency.

To install the latest developmental version from
[github](https://github.com/) you will need the R package
[remotes](https://cran.r-project.org/package=remotes):

``` r
remotes::install_github("maRce10/PhenotypeSpace")

#load package
library(PhenotypeSpace)
```

Please cite [PhenotypeSpace](https://github.com/maRce10/PhenotypeSpace)
as follows:

Araya-Salas, M., & K. Odom. 2022. PhenotypeSpace: and R package to
quantify and compare phenotypic trait spaces. R package version 0.1.0.

# Package index

## Space features

Measure space features

- [`space_similarity()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/space_similarity.md)
  : Pairwise similarities of phenotype spaces
- [`rarefact_space_similarity()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/rarefact_space_similarity.md)
  : Calculates rarefacted space overlaps
- [`space_size()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/space_size.md)
  : Estimates the size of phenotypic spaces
- [`rarefact_space_size()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/rarefact_space_size.md)
  : Estimates rarefacted size of phenotypic spaces
- [`space_size_difference()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/space_size_difference.md)
  : Estimates pairwise size differences of phenotypic spaces
- [`rarefact_space_size_difference()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/rarefact_space_size_difference.md)
  : Calculates rarefacted space size differences

## Curating detection datasets

Data exploration and manipulation

- [`binary_triangular_matrix()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/binary_triangular_matrix.md)
  : Get binary triangular matrices
- [`rectangular_to_triangular()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/rectangular_to_triangular.md)
  : Convert rectangular pairwise matrices to triangular matrices
- [`distance_to_rectangular()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/distance_to_rectangular.md)
  : Convert pairwise distance matrices to rectangular matrices
- [`plot_space()`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/plot_space.md)
  : Plot bidimensional trait spaces

## Built in datasets

Dataset included in PhenotypeSpace

- [`example_space`](https://marce10.github.io/PhenotypeSpace/reference/example_space.md)
  : Example bi-dimensional space data
